messages:
Morgan: Hey team — quick question as we roll out the per-tenant compat hooks for v3->v4: what's the plan for telemetry? We need visibility into who hits shims and the latency/cost impact. Also need an opt-out for privacy.

Kyle: +1. My rough proposal: emit a shim span in tracing (span name `shim.exec`) and a counter metric `compat.hits` with tags {tenant_hash, shim_name, outcome}. Default sampling 10% for traces, metrics always emitted.

Sana: 10% sampling seems risky for small tenants — you can miss regressions. Suggest sticky sampling: 100% trace sampling for the first 24h after a tenant first hits a shim, then decay to 10%.

Elaine: We must avoid any PII leaking. Tenant identifiers should be hashed before tagging. Also redact any prompt/content from shim logs.

Frank: What about cost / performance overhead? Tracing adds overhead and storage cost. Maybe prefer histograms for duration and only create full spans on error or when duration > 50ms.

Kyle: Agreed. Implementation idea: always emit metric `compat.duration_ms` (histogram) and increment `compat.hits`. Create a trace span only if duration > 50ms OR outcome != success. That keeps common-case low-cost.

Morgan: Good. We also want rollout visibility in Console for product — per-tenant % traffic on shim vs native so we can proactively contact customers.

Sana: Console should compute ratios from metrics (not scan logs). That means we need a consistent `shim_name` tag and fixed metric names. Also add short-term retention for these metrics (30 days) and longer aggregated rollups (90d) for trends.

Elaine: For EU/regulatory tenants, default telemetry opt-out. Add tenant config flag `telemetry.compat_shim` that defaults false for EU/regulated orgs. Needs clear UI and audit log.

Frank: Rough checklist for the infra work:
1) Define metric names + tags in RFC addendum
2) Instrument runtime to emit `compat.hits` and `compat.duration_ms` with hashed tenant id
3) Implement sticky sampling (100% first 24h) and trace gating (duration/error)
4) Tenant setting for telemetry opt-in/out + migration of EU defaults
5) Console panel (per-tenant shim ratio + small sparkline)
6) Retention policy: metrics 30d raw, 90d aggregated

Kyle: I'll draft the RFC addendum with exact metric names, example code snippet for runtime, and cost estimates for Prom/Trace storage. Will also ping @eng-infra for cardinality guardrails.

Morgan: Example header we can add to requests so downstream validators can attribute shim usage (store only hashed tenant):
```
X-Compat-Info: shim=v3_to_v4; tenant_hash=sha256:abc123...; sample=1
```
(Sana: make sure the hash algo is explicit in the tag so we can rotate)

deploy-bot: compat-telemetry-proto merged and deployed to canary (deploy id: d-202373). Monitoring enabled. :rocket:

Kyle: I'll follow up with a PR for the addendum and a small prototype in runtime. @Elaine I'll include the privacy checklist.

Morgan: Priorities: sticky sampling + EU opt-out + masking. Thanks all — I'll sync with product for console mockups and then we can schedule a short RFC follow-up meeting.
